units.source_text: 女人已经装束打扮完毕。

en.t: The woman had already finished dressing and making herself up.

units.source_text: 和衣服配套的劳动裤，淡绿色底碎白点，似乎透出了薄荷味的伤筋膏药气味，

en.t: The work pants matched her clothes, pale green with tiny white dots, and seemed to give off the minty smell of a medicated plaster,

units.source_text: 这样一打扮，他什么话也说不出来。

en.t: dressed like that, she left him unable to say anything.

units.source_text: 看来还是自己想得太多了吧。

en.t: It seemed he had simply been thinking too much after all.

units.source_text: 身处如此异常的环境，再加上睡眠不足，变得多少有些妄想也是在所难免的吧。

en.t: In such an abnormal situation, and with too little sleep besides, it was probably unavoidable that he would become somewhat delusional.
